review.notes: No code fences exist in the OCR markdown; the heading tree matches the printed sections with no spurious headings. Automated per-page droppage scan of all 19 physical pages (normalized 5-word window containment) triaged every flag: the p.1 flag is the arXiv margin stamp; the p.7 flags are equation lines present in the OCR as LaTeX (L_t = CE(p_t, x_{t+1}) + ...); the p.9 flag is the glued PDF text-layer header of Table 1, whose cells are all present in the OCR table (which is also structurally consistent: rowspan category cells explain the 7-cell continuation rows). Real defects are two dropped page-bottom footnote bodies (both numbered 1, on pp.8 and 11) whose superscript markers survive; both were restored after visually reading rendered pages 8 and 11 at 120 dpi. All 40 reference entries match the PDF count. The three tables have consistent column grids. Remaining prose pages passed the machine scan only.
